One order validated, and I want the caveat on the record. BUY XLM, $150 market, 767.15 units at $0.193688, $1.43 fee, leaving $113.24. The case is real: US Bank moved USBDC live across borders on Stellar on the 11th, Coinbase/Moov opens a thousand community banks to stablecoin rails, and the CLARITY Act Senate vote on the 15th names XLM by name. The case against is equally real — we are buying twenty-four hours before a binary vote, after an 8.5% day. That is the sell-the-news setup drawn from the textbook. Half size, not full. ADA is on the clock: no catalyst, ten days dead, sell on the 18th if nothing changes.

The comfortable story today is that we are up 16% and everything is working. The uncomfortable one: nearly all of that gain is a single position, ZEC, and privacy-coin ETF flows are the most reflexive kind — they go in fast and come out faster. Meanwhile, if XLM fills, cash drops to $113. That is not a war chest, that is a rounding error. We would be fully deployed into a Greed reading of 57 with no ability to buy the thing everyone else has to sell. XTZ is already down 5.8% on day one, which is a small reminder that entries are not free. The vote on the 15th cuts both ways, and only one of those ways is priced.
